name: Enchilada Sauce
siboNotes: Commercial enchilada sauces often contain onion and garlic powder, making them high in fructans. Start with small portions and check ingredient labels carefully.
preparationTips: Check labels for onion and garlic - choose brands that use only chili powder and spices
Make homemade sauce using garlic-infused oil instead of garlic powder
Look for 'FODMAP-friendly' labeled versions in health food stores
Dilute with low-FODMAP broth if sauce is too concentrated
alternatives: Homemade sauce with chili powder and cumin only
Salsa verde made without onion or garlic
Plain tomato sauce with Mexican spices
Chipotle peppers in adobo sauce (small amounts)
